text:
Emma: Heads up — invoice INV-2026-0456 didn't pick up the Q2 contract credit (CC-7892). Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0456 :confused:
Omar: ugh, saw this earlier when spinning up reserved nodes in us-west-2. Credits should auto-apply at invoice generation, right?
Li: Yep, automation is supposed to match by account + contract id. Can you paste the account id and contract id?
Emma: Account: ac_5401, ContractCredit: CC-7892. I double-checked the commitment dashboard and the credit shows active until 2026-07-01.
Sanjay: @Emma I'm looking now. Billing service shows a failed webhook on 2026-03-18T14:12Z with 422 from ledger-service: "mismatch_currency".
Billing Bot: Ticket #BILL-2147 created for invoice INV-2026-0456 — billing automation failure. Assigned to Sanjay. :white_check_mark:
Emma: mismatch_currency? This account is USD and contract is in USD. Weird.
Sanjay: I pulled the raw ledger entry: 
```
POST /apply-credit
{ "account":"ac_5401","credit_id":"CC-7892","amount":10000, "currency":"USD" }
Response: 422 { "error":"credit_currency":"EUR" }
```
Marie: FYI sales signed contract in EUR originally, but finance converted the credit to USD during onboarding. That could explain a mismatch in the ledger record vs the contract metadata.
Omar: Is this a data-mapping edge case between onboarding service and ledger? Could be how conversions are stored.
Ash: quick fix: I can run a manual apply with explicit currency override if we want to clear the invoice immediately. Otherwise we'll fix the mapping and re-run automation. Which do you prefer?
Emma: Manual apply please — customer is on Dedicated and needs invoice reconciled for their procurement.
Kate: I'll approve manual apply. @Ash go ahead but log the change and include original contract id in memo.
Sanjay: Doing manual apply now: ran ledger apply command: `ledgerctl apply-credit --acct ac_5401 --credit CC-7892 --invoice INV-2026-0456 --force-currency USD` — returned success. Applied $10,000 credit.
Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0456 updated, credit applied, outstanding balance reduced. Ticket #BILL-2147 updated.
Emma: Confirmed — invoice shows the credit. Thanks all. :relieved:
Li: Post-mortem action: I'll open infra ticket to add a validation step in the webhook that normalizes currency codes and fails early with telemetry. Also add a reconcile job to detect credits marked active but not applied.
Omar: Add an alert if a credit fails to apply 3 times in 24h for any account > $1k.
Marie: I'll coordinate with Sales to ensure contracts created in EUR have a clear conversion record in onboarding metadata.
Ash: I'll add the quick migration script to fix any existing records with mismatch_currency tag. PR incoming.
Sanjay: Closing BILL-2147 after manual apply and follow-ups. Leaving root cause as "currency metadata mismatch between onboarding and ledger" pending infra fix.
Kate: Great. Can someone drop the retrospective notes in #finance-runbook once Li has the infra ticket?
Emma: Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
